LanguageData.GeneDefChemicalNeedDurationDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} needs to ingest {0} on a regular basis to stay healthy. After {DEFICIENCYDURATION} without {0}, {PAWN_pronoun} will suffer from {0} deficiency.
LanguageData.LDD_HussarLuciferiumGeneDesc: Carriers of this gene need to ingest luciferium on a regular basis to stay healthy. After 10 days without luciferium, carriers will suffer from luciferium deficiency. After 20 days, it settles into a chronic deficiency that does not get any worse. It is never lethal, but it lasts until they ingest luciferium again.
LanguageData.LDD_ChronicIntro: Instead of a coma and death, an unsatisfied dependency settles into a chronic deficiency at the point where the coma used to start (day 30 for vanilla dependencies). These caps apply at that stage.
LanguageData.LDD_ConsciousnessCapTip: Below 30% a pawn falls unconscious, so the slider stops there. Other injuries still stack on top, so leave some margin.
LanguageData.LDD_MovingCapTip: Below 15% a pawn can no longer walk, so the slider stops there.
LanguageData.LDD_IncludeHussarTip: Hussar's luciferium dependency gene uses its own condition: coma after 20 days, death after 30. When ticked it gets the same chronic stage at day 20 instead.
